title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
A mycorrhizal root of Pinus halepensis, imaged by an XRF microscope (AttoMap) showing the allocation of potassium (green) and calcium (blue) into coral-like mycorrhizal structures. Also visible are manganese (pink), iron (red), and chlorine (orange), distributed along the root tissue. Exchange of nutrients is a major topic in this Special Focus dedicated to mycorrhizal networks. Image credit: Prepared by Sigray (Benicia, CA, USA) for the Weizmann Tree Lab.

This month's cover image is provided by the editors of the ‘Mycorrhizal Networks’ Special Focus, which features in this issue. This Special Focus includes articles that consider methodological aspects of measuring and mapping mycorrhizal networks, including novel approaches.
